caseName: Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railway Co. v. Beatty
caseNameFull: The Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railway Company, in Error v. W. W. Beatty
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. F'. C. Dillard and Mr. C. 0. Blake for the plaintiff in error. No appearance for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reyersed with costs, and cause remanded for further proceedings, upon the authority of Houston & Texas Cent. R. R. Co. v. Mayes, 201 U. S. 321; Yazoo & Miss. Valley Ry. Co. v. Greenwood Grocery Co., 227 U. S. 1.
